surface_rule: Categories are engine-internal by default; user-facing UI exposes only compressed choices.

families.name: Intent & Brief
families.purpose: Define what the tattoo is trying to be before drawing.

families.name: Reference Intelligence
families.purpose: Gather useful references without letting references become the design.

families.name: Composition Skeleton
families.purpose: Build the first-read structure before detail.

families.name: Style Grammar
families.purpose: Choose a coherent visual language rather than disconnected effects.

families.name: Body-Aware Concept
families.purpose: Shape the concept for the eventual body area from the beginning.

families.name: Construction Method
families.purpose: Move from rough thought to controlled drawing in passes.

families.name: Tattoo Readability
families.purpose: Protect the design from becoming visually clever but physically unreadable.

families.name: Originality Transform
families.purpose: Turn influences into a new design language instead of copying a source.

families.name: Direction Selection
families.purpose: Choose strong, meaningfully different directions before polishing.

families.name: Line Architecture
families.purpose: Make the line system deliberate, consistent, and tattoo-readable.

families.name: Value & Contrast
families.purpose: Build depth and longevity through intentional value separation.

families.name: Negative Space
families.purpose: Treat exposed skin as active structure rather than leftover emptiness.

families.name: Shape & Form
families.purpose: Correct geometry and volume before surface detail.

families.name: Texture & Shading Language
families.purpose: Use one coherent texture/shading system appropriate to the design.

families.name: Composition Polish
families.purpose: Make every element serve the primary read.

families.name: Style Consistency
families.purpose: Prevent a piece from becoming a pile of unrelated visual tricks.

families.name: Transform & Edit
families.purpose: Use digital transforms precisely and non-destructively.

families.name: Review & QC
families.purpose: Test the design under views that reveal hidden weaknesses.

families.name: Body Region Geometry
families.purpose: Understand the characteristic geometry of common placements.

families.name: Shape-to-Area Match
families.purpose: Match composition type to the geometry available.

families.name: Anatomical Flow
families.purpose: Make the tattoo move with the person instead of fighting the body.

families.name: Fit & Wrap
families.purpose: Control how much of the design turns away from the primary view.

families.name: Scale & Detail
families.purpose: Determine what amount of information the physical area can actually support.

families.name: Orientation
families.purpose: Keep image direction intentional when the body is at rest.

families.name: Placement Transform
families.purpose: Map flat artwork onto a photographed or modeled body surface.

families.name: Client & Skin Context
families.purpose: Record non-aesthetic constraints that change placement decisions.

families.name: Placement Approval
families.purpose: Make placement a deliberate reviewed state rather than an assumption.

families.name: Source Preparation
families.purpose: Create a stencil-specific derivative without destroying the artwork master.

families.name: Guide-Line Encoding
families.purpose: Encode different kinds of tattoo information with distinct stencil marks.

families.name: Detail Reduction
families.purpose: Remove information that will not transfer or will confuse execution.

families.name: Print Geometry
families.purpose: Guarantee the paper output matches intended physical scale and direction.

families.name: Transfer Paper Handling
families.purpose: Respect the structure and orientation of stencil transfer media.

families.name: Printer Setup
families.purpose: Make printing repeatable rather than trial-and-error.

families.name: Printed Stencil QC
families.purpose: Catch output failures before the stencil reaches skin.

families.name: Skin Placement Prep
families.purpose: Prepare for accurate transfer while preserving hygiene and alignment.

families.name: Set, Reapply & Verify
families.purpose: Treat the applied stencil as a checkpoint that must pass review.

families.name: Master Package
families.purpose: Keep editable, review, production, and metadata outputs distinct.

families.name: Export Formats
families.purpose: Choose formats by downstream need rather than habit.

families.name: Resolution & Scale
families.purpose: Preserve physical intent through export and print.

families.name: Color & Ink Behavior
families.purpose: Communicate intended ink behavior across devices and printed references.

families.name: Naming & Versioning
families.purpose: Make every file identify itself without opening it.

families.name: Artist Brief
families.purpose: Transfer creative intent without pretending the concept is execution-ready.

families.name: Placement Pack
families.purpose: Give the artist enough spatial context to understand the intended fit.

families.name: Provenance & Rights
families.purpose: Keep source lineage and permissions inspectable.

families.name: Handoff & Approval
families.purpose: Close the loop with explicit review, backup, and privacy states.
